leadText:
Jacqueline (Japanese: ジャクリーン Jacqueline) is a character of the day who appeared in Sobble Spies a Stealthy Strategy!.

She is an actress who starred alongside her in a popular action movie called , in which she portrays a spy. Due to the success of this movie, was made and slated to be directed by Kublock. While filming a scene for this movie, they were interrupted by , who attempted to steal Inteleon. When they battled and Goh, Inteleon was able to send them blasting off with . This caused Goh's Sobble to look up to Inteleon.

Jacqueline later appeared when Ash and Goh saved a crew member's from Team Rocket and praised Sobble on its work.

She reappeared in a flashback in Not Too Close for Comfort!.
